name: Multifractal Mountain Synthesis
definition: Synthesis of terrain height using seeded gradient noise, combining ridged and hybrid multifractal components, enhanced with domain warp, a super-elliptical peak mask, and a directional tilt gradient.
summary: Multifractal Mountain Synthesis generates realistic terrain height fields by combining seeded gradient noise with ridged and hybrid multifractal components, explicitly modeling mountainous topography through sharper peaks and geological features.
